title: That Head Bob? It's a Microsleep Stretch Reflex
caption:
Your head bob at your desk is actually a built-in alarm.
A drowsy cartoon office worker types 'I must stay awake' as the boss watches, his head droops, and he jolts back up with a startled 'Whoa!'
In a microsleep your neck muscle tone suddenly drops, the head starts to fall, and the stretch reflex fires, snapping it back up to wake you.
Have you ever caught yourself head-bobbing in a meeting?
Save this for your next long meeting and follow for more daily body science.
